pr_a.title: Skip placeholder and FALLBACK screens when creating bars
pr_a.body: ## Summary When monitors sleep or are unplugged, Qt substitutes a nameless placeholder screen and Hyprland creates its headless `FALLBACK` output. pr_a.title: Keep UPower rate when sysfs power read fails with ENODEV
pr_a.body: Single-battery HP/ACPI machines expose a `power_now` that passes `[[ -r ]]` but whose `read()` fails with `ENODEV`, so the script gets `""` and `awk` coerces it to `0W`, discarding UPower's correct `energy-rate` (~16-30W). pr_b.title: Keep UPower rate when sysfs power reads fail or are non-numeric
pr_b.body: Fixes #12735. ## Problem `omarchy battery status` shows `0W` while discharging, even though UPower knows the real rate (time-left is correct, only wattage is wrong).
